items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms of ringed topoi f and g, there is a canonical distinguished triangle Lf^*L_g -> L_{g o f} -> L_f -> Lf^*L_g[1] in D(O_1) (source lines 3944-3955). The proof sets h = g o f and uses the pullback statement to identify f^{-1}L_g with the cotangent complex of the map of sheaves of rings h^{-1}O_3 -> f^{-1}O_2, noting that this is a complex of flat f^{-1}O_2-modules; the triangle in question is then the triangle of the sheaf-theoretic triangle lemma for the three sheaves of rings involved.
